column7: RD-TLA-OWED-FIX-1 (TLC trace docs/formal/owed-audit/pendingfault_silent.cfg, ask rd-tla-owed-silent-loss (a)): the pending record of an owed row was refused in the revocation transaction (collect-only fallback) and the process died at the post-commit append; the rows lived only in memory until after the append wait, so they were lost with no record and no log line naming them. The late record is now written right after the commit (queueOwedRowsLate; commitOwingAudit for a plain suspend) and every row is named in a SECURITY line before the commit. The test refuses CreatePendingAuditEvent once and Goexits at the first append (RemoveProjectMember, two rows; SuspendSecret), asserts the rows are pending and backfilled from a fresh core; with the pending table refusing everything it asserts every row was named before the commit. Red at 355d3ab28 (all 4 subtests; 35/35 kinds of the pending-record-error+crash-at-audit case in TestRevocationAudit_EffectCommitsAndRowIsOwedNeverLost).
